Ava: Heads up team  SignalLight prep checklist: booth layout, two speaker slots, post-event webinar, launch post + benchmark narrative. Need owners by EOD.

Mina: I'll take the webinar logistics and registration flow (Zoom + HubSpot). Do we want a prerecorded demo or live Q&A?
Rory: Live Q&A but record it. Keep it 30 mins: 10m overview, 15m demo, 5m Q&A.
Eli: For benchmarks: Eng can pull latency vs token cost for our 13B quantized variant. I can coordinate. Need examples and 3 charts max.
Ava: Perfect. Diego: messaging needs two variants: technical (benchmarks, throughput) and product (ease, pricing). We'll A/B test on LinkedIn.
Diego: noted. I'll do two headline versions and 3 supporting bullets each.

Eli: SDR queue for demo interest, AE flag for companies with >100 employees. I will add a Webhook to push JSON to /integrations/hubspot/import.
Rory: For lead capture fallback: badge-scan spreadsheet template here: https://drive.redwood/templates/badge-scan.csv. Keep QR as primary.
Ava: Swag update: ordered sticker packs, tees, and a small notebook. ETA Wed. PromoBot: any shipping updates?
PromoBot: Shipping update: swag order #RLW-443 delivered to office 2025-07-09 14:22.

Diego: Will label the doc "draft-for-eng-review" and ping reviewers.

Mina: I'll collect bios and add to the shared folder. Also setting up stage rehearsal Thu 5pm at HQ.
Eli: For demo failover: bring a laptop with local model run, and 2-min video snippets of the demo. Put them on an offline USB.
Ava: Also: lead routing detail: form fields -> hubspot property "source" = signallight, "interest" = demo/product/enterprise. Make sure we add auto-assign owner rule for companies >50 employees to AE.
Diego: Will reflect that in the launch post CTA: "Book a demo" -> calendar link; "Try sandbox" -> quickstart link.
Rory: Need an index card for booth script: 1) Elevator (30s), 2) Ask (what do they build?), 3) CTA (scan QR). I'll draft quick script for staff.

Ava: Confirmed: 10-13: Mina + Eli, 13-16: Ava + Diego, 16-19: Rory + Jules (Jules covers design and table ops).
PromoBot: Calendar reminder: load-in Fri 07:30-09:30. Dock assigned.
Diego: Post-event: schedule the recap blog within 48h. I'll draft with Mina and Eli for the benchmark section. Want headline options?
Ava: Yes. Two options: tech-first "How we served 5k tokens/s at SignalLight" and product-first "Ship LLM features without infra headaches". We'll test which resonates.
Eli: For the bench figures in the blog, include method section: hardware=gpu-v5, batch=8, quant=4-bit. Keep raw numbers in appendix.
Rory: Also capture attendee quotes at booth (short soundbites) for social. We'll designate someone to record quick vox pops.
Mina: I'll run post-event follow-up: 24h: thank you + recording; 3 days: targeted nurture per interest; 2 weeks: sales outreach for enterprise.
Diego: I'll queue organic posts and 2 paid boosts targeting devs and platform teams in NA/EU. Budget approval pending from Emily.
Ava: Outstanding items: design assets, eng bench numbers, speaker bios, swag confirmation, and sales mapping. Owners: Diego, Eli, Rory, PromoBot (shipping). Freeze plan Fri 17:00 if no blockers.
Eli: I'll get numbers by Mon 11:00.
Rory: Bios due Tue noon.
Mina: Webinar flow and calendar invites by Wed.
